title: Te Karanga Mai i te Hōhonu
intro: I hoha te pononga a te Atua Aroha ki tētahi iwi pakeke, ā, i mua i te whakaaetanga, ka haere atu ia. I tae atu tēnei tangata ki tētahi wāhi kāore anō kia tae atu tētahi tangata, ā, i reira ka rangona te karanga ki te Atua i roto i ngā paparanga o te pōuri. I te putanga mai o te ngoikore engari kua rerekē, ka noho tēnei wairua hei akoranga mutunga kore mō te manawanui, te ripeneta pono, me te aroha mutunga kore o te Kaihanga. Ka taea e koe te wetewete i te mea ngaro?
clues: I tonoa ahau hei karere ki tōku iwi, engari i takahia e rātou ngā rohe katoa i runga i tō rātou whakaponokore, ā, i kore ai rātou e whakarongo.
I riri ahau i tā rātou whakakorenga, ā, i rere atu ahau i tōku iwi i mua i te taenga mai o te whakahau a Allah.
I eke ahau ki runga i tētahi kaipuke kua utaina rawatia, ā, i maka rota mātou hei whakatau ko wai ka maka ki waho.
I makaia ahau ki te moana e ngaru ana, ā, i horomia ahau e tetahi ika nui.
I roto i ngā paparanga e toru o te pōuri — te puku, te moana hohonu, me te whenua i raro — i karanga ahau ki tōku Ariki me te ripeneta pono.
I puta ake ahau i te ika ki uta, ngoikore ana, ngenge ana, ā, ka tupu ake he hue ki runga i ahau. Ka whakapono tōku iwi, neke atu i te kotahi rau mano.
